description: §44.3 — a `.prepare()` on a `?{}` result inside a channel `onserver:*` WebSocket handler body SHALL be compile error E-SQL-006. Pins the emit-server WS handler body-emit path (`_wsFnOpts`), a distinct opts object from the HTTP route handlers; before the fix it wired no `.prepare()` sink, silently dropping the diagnostic on the WS `onserver:*` sub-path while the runtime IIFE still emitted in `function handleMessage(...)`.
rationale: The channel `onserver:*` handler is emitted as a plain callable server function; its body lowers through emitLogicNode with `_wsFnOpts`, which now threads the function-scoped `_sqlPrepareErrors` sink (drained deduped at the tail), so a `.prepare()` in a realtime handler surfaces E-SQL-006.
